sources.notes: Public repository archived 2026-10-02; multi-GB and source assets are not GLB-ready. Keep license notice when distributing. Partial source acquisition 2026-11-13: four archived model ZIPs (medical FBX-only), two sample animation FBXs in one archive; exact Drive IDs confined to private receipt; GLB conversion initially failed due missing Blender numpy and is not yet validated. Two GLBs in Drive passed actual WebGL2/Three.js r185 loader, mixer, rendered triangles and reload checks; not fully released. Batch02 added eight more complete original avatar archives to Drive (103 of 115 still pending), and four additional GLBs passed Chromium Three.js r185 skinned texture and animation-mixer render/reload smoke. Source/package SHA-256 verified before upload; Google Drive metadata readback confirmed size/parent; no Drive roundtrip byte hash, visual approval, mobile benchmark or long-session proof. See batch02 private receipts. Completion run 43551948111 converted four earlier source-only batch02 models and smoke tested all ten GLBs, archived twenty separate Chrome render screenshots and private receipts. Darker browser-render facial/material exposure than source previews flagged for visual QA; no production approval. Source archive count unchanged. Cloud remaining-source pilot group0 acquired 10 original avatars into five Drive-verified nested transport packs; 93 original avatar sources remain. No new GLB conversion or visual signoff. FINAL ACQUISITION 2026-11-13 local (2026-11-14 UTC): 103 further original sources obtained in 11 cloud batches (group4 had one filename whitespace issue fixed by isolated retry) and archived to original private Drive originals. 52 new transport-pack files, 65 originals-folder objects total; all 115 stable source IDs have private archive references. Source SHA256/Git blobs verified pre-upload, Drive provider filename/size/MIME/parent readbacks passed. Historical Medical_Female_01 source FBX-only; 105 sources have no GLB yet; only 10 GLBs smoke tested and none production approved. Master retrieval records are in private Drive, not public repo.
